title: BUGFIX — Bypass dedup ledger for synthesised clips to prevent 0-clip runs after first discovery-fallback pass
rationale: Sprint-1408 synthesises pre-qualified clips from discovery metadata when viralClipsCount=0. The discovery_id is deterministic (sha256(url:topicId)), so after the first synthesised run the dedup ledger (Stage 3.5) records these clip_ids. On the next run the same discovery_ids are generated again and filterNewClips() filters them all out, producing 0 clips. The dedup ledger was designed for actual downloaded video clips, not metadata-only synthesised entries. Fix: when clipsAreSynthesized=true, skip ledger.filterNewClips and use qualifiedClipsRaw directly. Log the bypass so it's visible in pipeline output.

tasks.description: agents/scs001-orchestrator/index.ts Stage 3.5: change 'const qualifiedClipsDeduped = this.ledger.filterNewClips(qualifiedClipsRaw)' to bypass the ledger when clipsAreSynthesized=true. Use: 'const qualifiedClipsDeduped = clipsAreSynthesized ? (console.log("[Orchestrator] Synthesised clips — skipping dedup ledger"), qualifiedClipsRaw) : this.ledger.filterNewClips(qualifiedClipsRaw);'. Keep clipsDeduplicated=0 for synthesised path.
